hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(py)$'; then flake8 $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>&1 | head -20; fi; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(css|tsx|ts)$'; then grep -nE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|[^-a-z][0-9]+px' $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'tokens' | head -20; fi; exit 0
